title: Tunka Mayan Warawaranakax qunqurt’asipxiwa
intro: Quran ukan mä chimpupax wawatpach mä jach’a uñjäwiw churatäna — mä samka alaxpachankir cuerponakan respeto ukamp qunqurt’asipxatapa. Uka visionajj janïr phoqaskakipanjja, walja maranakaw traicionatäñasa, tʼaqanuqtañasa, kʼarinak juchañchañasa ukat carcelar jistʼantatäñasa pasañapäna. ¿Khitis aka jan sayt’ir almax sarnaqäwipax Quran ukan juk’amp jach’a jaljankiwa?
clues: Mä kutix waynäskayätwa, mä muspharkañ samkampiw bendicitäna, uka samkax pachpa awkijas jan yatiyañatakiw iwxtʼitäna.
Pachpa jilanakajax envidiasiñat juykhuptayasisaw naya contra amtapxäna ukat mä manqhankir chʼamaka phuchʼuruw jaquntapxitäna.
Jaya oraqeruw irpapjjetäna ukat mä jachʼa funcionarion utaparuw aljapjjetäna, ukanwa suma uñjatäyäta ukat mä jachʼa luräwiruw sartayäta.
Kʼari juchañchäwinakaw jan cheqaparjam carcelar jistʼantatäñajatak yanaptʼitäna, ukampis uka chʼamaka cheqanjja, Diosar mayisiñampi ukat qonqortʼasiñampiw chuymachtʼitäna.
Allah jupax samkanak qhanañchañ yatiñampiw bendicitu, ukax qhipharux uraqi apnaqirin nayraqataparuw puriyitu ukat mä jach’a cargo de confianza ukar jach’anchayitu.
Walja maranaka jaljtasinxa, munat familiajampiw mayamp jikista, ukat wawatpach tunka mayan warawaranaka, inti ukat phaxsi nayar qunqurt’asis samkayäta ukax qhiparuxa phuqhasxänwa.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
